lastResponse.text: I’m really glad you called. If you can’t breathe right now, call nine one one now, or tell someone nearby to call nine one one for you. Your safety comes first. I can stay with you while we get a live crisis person on the line. If you want, I can also connect you to HAVEN’s crisis line: 541… 296… 1662.
